messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes and internal announce for Wed night deploy (change window 2026-03-25 22:00-23:00 PT). Need ops pin, canary list, and rollback criteria.
priya: On it. Drafting bullets + an accessibility (a11y) blurb for screen-reader users. Where should I put the canary lanes list?
alex: Canary lanes: prod-canary-1 (eng), prod-canary-lite (mobile), eu-canary. We'll pin model to model:v1.8.2-quant. Confirm fallback model + rollback triggers.
matt: OK to pin to v1.8.2-quant for canary. Fallback -> v1.8.1-fp16. Rollback criteria: either 3x baseline error rate OR p95 latency > 2s sustained for 5m OR eval-set regression (automated delta > 5% on chatty prompts).
elaine: Small accessibility note: RN must include alt text for screenshots and a short "how to report accessibility issues" link. Also l10n: we're only blasting en-US this cycle — l10n team notified.
priya: Draft link: https://docs/internal/rn/drafts/1771234567 (placeholder). I'll add pin/fallback + rollback bullets and the a11y copy.
alex: Ops — please run a deploybot dry-run so we can confirm no surprises. Post the exact command here.
matt: /deploy dry-run release/2026-03-25 --canary prod-canary-1 --pin model:v1.8.2-quant
deploy-bot: Received command from matt. Dry-run scheduled.
deploy-bot: Steps: validate manifests -> OK; check quotas -> OK; canary pools available -> 3 GPUs free.
deploy-bot: Preview: https://deploy.internal/preview/1771234567
alex: Good. If dry-run passes we'll send internal announce in #eng and #product 1h before window. Who volunteers to post?
elaine: I can handle #eng + #product. @sam can you queue the broader internal blast (company-wide internal-only)?
sam: Yep, I can queue it. I need final RN copy by Tue 17:00 PT to prep comms + subject line.
priya: Will deliver final RN by Tue 16:00 PT (gives time for review). I'll include a short "how to report regressions" with link to incident template.
matt: Ops note: pin the model in runtime config to prevent autoscaler/optimizer from swapping quant profile during canary. Add `pin_model: true` in rollout policy.
alex: Good catch. Also include an observability dash link and a small cost delta estimate in the RN. Priya, can you add cost delta?
priya: Added: estimated token cost delta +12% for v1.8.2-quant vs baseline. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/dashboards/release-1771234567
sam: For comms: use "internal only" tag and add "do not forward" to the subject line. We'll coordinate embargo windows.
matt: One more ops check — change window approved by oncall? @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: Approved. Oncall will monitor during the window and has pager thresholds set per the runbook.
elaine: We'll also include a tiny rollback playbook in the RN: owners + 3-step clear actions so non-ops folks know who to ping.
alex: Draft rollback snippet idea: 1) Disable canary traffic (SRE) 2) Revert model pin -> model:v1.8.1-fp16 (Matt) 3) Re-run smoke tests and sign off (Elaine). Who approves final rollback? Elaine + Matt.
elaine: Ack — we'll own rollback approval. I'll prepare the exact commands.
deploy-bot: Dry-run complete. No issues detected. Simulated traffic: p95=0.8s, error rate=0.2%. Ready for real deploy if sign-offs complete.
alex: Excellent. Final asks: priya add cost delta + dashboard links (done), matt add `pin_model: true` to rollout policy, elaine add a11y + rollback commands. We'll reconvene Tue 17:30 for final sign-off. :tada:
